instruction: Use VLC media player to extract the soundtrack from the video file on the desktop and create an MP3 file named "Baby Justin Bieber.mp3" on the desktop.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires extracting soundtrack from video using VLC. Evaluator verifies MP3 file was created with minimum 100KB size on the desktop.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts all necessary file properties: existence, size, MIME type, extension, and audio type flag
Metric properly validates file exists at the correct path (/home/user/Desktop/Baby Justin Bieber.mp3)
Metric verifies file size meets minimum requirement (>= 100KB), which is reasonable for extracted audio
Metric validates file is actually an audio file using MIME type check (via 'file --mime-type -b' command)
Metric verifies file has .mp3 extension as required by instruction
All observable requirements from the instruction are verified: correct path, MP3 format, valid audio file, reasonable size
Logic flow is correct: getter extracts state via bash commands, metric validates all critical aspects
